Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

You might be our missing piece if you have: 
Strong hands-on experience designing, configuring, and operating Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, resource management, networking, and security.
Experience writing and maintaining reusable Terraform modules for Azure infrastructure.
Experience working with Azure DevOps Repos and building and maintaining YAML pipelines for CI/CD automation.
Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory.
Familiarity with Azure cost management tools and practices, and the ability to monitor resource usage and design cost-efficient solutions.
A proactive approach to troubleshooting and taking ownership of infrastructure issues.
Experience with code reviews and technical documentation, and the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate across teams.
A sense of belonging while reading about our culture.
 We would be thrilled if you have 
Hands-on experience with Azure Private Link, VPNs, firewall rules, and private DNS.
Experience operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or designing highly available Azure infrastructure across availability zones and regions.
 We will be working together on 
Designing, building, and operating secure Azure infrastructure for the RebelDot Process Industries data platform.
Developing and maintaining reusable Terraform modules to standardize infrastructure provisioning across environments.
Managing Azure DevOps repositories and building YAML pipelines to automate infrastructure and data platform deployments.
Deploying and supporting Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory environments, including their connectivity and access configuration.
Monitoring resource usage, infrastructure health, and network connectivity, and identifying opportunities to optimize Azure costs.
Working with data engineers and other technical stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, review infrastructure and pipeline changes, and document deployment and operational practices.
